correctness.rationale: For all simple labelled cycles n>=3, put b_i=f_i-1; the edge condition is b_{i-1}+b_{i+1} != b_i+b_{i+2}. The overlapping 3-bit-state transitions give a bijection with closed walks, and the three directed simple cycles (lengths/weights (4,z),(2,z),(4,z^3)) yield det(I-uM)=1-zu^2-(z+z^3)u^4+z^4u^8 by disjoint-cycle expansion. The formal -u d/du log determinant gives every coefficient after subtracting trace(2)=2z. Odd lengths vanish, bit complementation gives symmetry; cyclic gaps between 1s are <=4, and all minimum-support solutions are 4 rotations for n=0 mod4 and n uniquely short-gap configurations for n=2 mod4. Independently enumerated every bit assignment for n=3..16 and matched polynomial coefficients/extremizers, not extrapolating finite cases to all n.
